name: DiffTaichi Differentiable Physical Simulation
summary: Differentiate through procedural simulation programs using source-level transformations and reverse-mode tapes.
summary_zh: 通过程序级变换及反向传播记录，在物理模拟计算中高效计算梯度。
core_idea: Provide differentiable high-performance physical simulation infrastructure for gradients through time-stepping programs.
innovation: Makes gradient-based inverse design and parameter optimization more practical in simulated physics.
limitations: Discontinuities and solver approximations can spoil gradients.
Differentiation does not alone guarantee physical-model accuracy.

start_here.why: ICLR differentiable simulation framework and representative applications.
start_here.focus: Program transformations and physical gradient computation.

curation_note: Representative publication checked; recommendations are advisory and application-specific clinical claims require separate evidence.
